geography: 21 study countries in the Americas and Asia; no extrapolation outside evidence domain

response_source.citation: Childs et al. (2025), Climate warming is expanding dengue burden in the Americas and Asia, PNAS

closed_damage_channels.dengue_mortality: Potential overlap with GIVE Cromar all-cause temperature mortality; requires an explicit cause-deleted or combined mortality target.
closed_damage_channels.lost_wages: Potential overlap with the GIVE labor-productivity extension; count either disease-attributable lost work or the overlapping labor loss, not both.
closed_damage_channels.air_pollution_health: Belongs to the separate air-pollution module.

scc_release_rule: additive_scc_allowed may be true only if every preceding required pulse, valuation, overlap, validation, and normalization gate is true
